ios.desc:
Do you love Art and its History? Get inspired & Learn something new every day!
Smart Art helps everyone to brighten up the day and enjoy the unrivaled works of art, discover brilliant artists and learn more about their art and its history in a fun and interactive way.

In Smart App we have brought together:
- curious and relatable stories and quizzes on arts and culture written in a witty, conversational tone,
- fully-searchable collection of high-quality images of beautiful and extraordinary artworks,
- and spiced it up with fun interactive features to take art discovery among young and old, enthusiasts or pros to a new level of engagement and fun. 

KEY FEATURES

• Daily Stories - 1000+ original short thematic history and artwork background stories that enlighten, entertain, and inspire. New one released every day!
• Art History Quizzes - another way to discover brilliant art and check your knowledge along the way.
• Preview Bubbles - fun and entertaining Video & Photo previews of original content and art history news.
• Easy to navigate Collection - Over 80,000 classified paintings (continuously growing and upgrading) from Medieval Manuscripts to Abstract Expressionism.
• Thematic Search - Browse artworks by filtering them by style, genre, artist, school, and other tags.
• Home Screen WIDGET - Enjoy new art every hour & Learn its story in 1 click.
• Artwork Zoom - Explore masterpieces in every detail.
• Personal collection - Save and share your favorite pieces.
• Push Notifications - Never miss your daily art inspiration and insights.
• Ad-FREE in all modes - 'cause we respect art and its viewers [you!].

Our mission is to make you feel inspired and know your way around in arts and culture. Use Smart Art for pleasure and leisure, in addition to your art education or professional research.

SUPPORTED BY ART LOVERS LIKE YOU

Smart Art isn't supported by banner ads. It is supported by art lovers like You. If you find this experience valuable, keep this project evolving and improving by becoming a subscriber. 

THE STORY BEHIND SMART ART

We’re a family team of two passionate art lovers, researchers, and ArtTech enthusiasts exploring new ways to make world art heritage more accessible and take brilliant artists of the past out of obscurity. 

Smart Art was born as an online community of thousands of passionate art lovers meeting daily to see and enjoy beautiful art and discuss the story behind it.
